_comment_2: This file defines when skills should be auto-activated based on user prompts

plugin.name: your-plugin-name
plugin._comment_namespace: Namespace prevents conflicts (e.g., 'claude', 'tanstack', 'hono'). Skills will be referenced as 'namespace/skill-name'.

example-skill.description: Optional human-readable description of when to use this skill

promptTriggers._comment_keywords: Case-insensitive literal matches. Example: 'create example' matches 'I want to create example'
promptTriggers._comment_patterns: Regex patterns with case-insensitive flag. Example: '(create|add).*?example' matches 'How do I add a new example?'

example-skill._comment_type: domain = domain-specific skill | guardrail = safety/quality enforcement (future)
example-skill._comment_enforcement: suggest = show recommendation (MVP) | block = require skill use (future) | warn = show warning (future)
example-skill._comment_priority: critical = must-use | high = strongly recommended | medium = moderately useful | low = optional

_example_skill-creator.description: Generate new Claude Code skills with proper structure

_example_hook-creator.description: Generate Claude Code hooks for workflow automation

_tip_1: Use 2-4 keywords per skill (most common phrases)
_tip_2: Use 1-3 patterns per skill (capture intent variations)
_tip_3: Test patterns with real user prompts
_tip_4: Avoid overly broad patterns that match everything
_tip_5: Balance precision (avoid false positives) with recall (catch all relevant prompts)
